conditionLibrary.excelsior-individual-evaluation: Excelsior evaluates each student individually at admission under the policies and curriculum in effect then; this published guide equivalency is not a personal credit award.
conditionLibrary.excelsior-c-minus-pass: Excelsior applies outside credit only with the equivalent of C- or higher and posts it as Pass (P), outside the Excelsior GPA; confirm how Excelsior treats a pass/fail provider grade against this requirement’s minimum grade.
conditionLibrary.excelsior-ace-window: ACE- or NCCRS-recommended credit must be completed during the period for which credit was recommended; send the official provider transcript.
conditionLibrary.excelsior-duplicative-credit: Excelsior applies only one of two sources whose content overlaps by 50% or more, so do not combine this course with another source covering the same subject.
conditionLibrary.excelsior-partnership-residency: If you enroll through an Excelsior partnership (for example Sophia’s partner tuition), Excelsior’s partner guides require at least 15 Excelsior course credits for students admitted after December 31, 2024.
conditionLibrary.excelsior-transfer-time-limit: Excelsior’s partner transfer guidelines say undergraduate transfer credit must have been earned within 10 years before enrollment, while the Grade Scale, GPA, and Credit Application policy says there is generally no time limit; complete the course close to admission and confirm.
conditionLibrary.excelsior-math-distribution-limits: Excelsior applies no more than three mathematics courses below calculus to any degree and no more than one terminal, non-major or appreciation mathematics course.
